data.body:
Fixed and merged in Gerrit change 2906 (commit 385ddee1bc02a on Gerrit main).

RCA: the parity regression test depended on `git show c57057f41:...`, so Gerrit `fetch-depth: 1` checkouts could lack the historical object and fail with exit 128 even though the change under test was unrelated.

Fix: vendored the historical c57057f41 workflow files as committed test fixtures and changed the parity regression to read those fixtures, preserving the oracle without network fetches, skips, or deeper CI checkout.

Evidence: RED fixture-missing focused test failed before fixtures existed; focused parity regression passed after fixtures; full `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` passed (39 tests); shallow-clone proof showed `git show c57057f41:.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml` fails with 128 while the focused test passes; `make lint` passed; full `make verify` passed with GIT_CONFIG_* unset; Gerrit 2906 received LLM-Review+1 and Verified+1 and was submitted.
